phases.title: Trustworthy foundation
phases.exit: Real identity/session ownership, preserved encrypted store, tested self-hosted recovery and honest capability states.

phases.title: Builder workflows
phases.exit: Create/import/reference/deliver/recover an application configuration with accessible native UI and scoped AI context.

phases.title: Team automation
phases.exit: Approvals, rotation, leases and sync demonstrate denial, retry, revocation and provider recovery.

phases.title: Controlled AI workspace
phases.exit: Approved actions, workload-bound delivery, egress restrictions and durable redacted receipts pass adversarial tests.

phases.title: DevSCIF deployment profiles
phases.exit: Explicit deployment/control requirements and independently reviewed evidence; no certification inferred from branding.
